title: CBSE CLASS 1 — Environmental Studies | Economic Activities
description: Subject-wise test on Economic Activities (Environmental Studies) for CBSE CLASS 1. 25Q.
subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Who teaches you new things in school?

options.explanation: Doctors treat sick people but do not teach in schools.
Postmen deliver letters and parcels but do not teach.
Teachers are responsible for educating students in schools.
Farmers grow crops but do not teach in schools.

questions.explanation: A teacher's main role is to teach students and help them learn new things in school.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: What does a doctor do when you are sick?

options.explanation: Stitching clothes is the job of a tailor.
Doctors provide medical treatment and medicine to sick people.
Building houses is the job of a construction worker or carpenter.
Delivering letters is the job of a postman.

questions.explanation: Doctors are responsible for examining sick people, diagnosing their illness, and providing treatment or medicine.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Where does a policeman usually work to keep us safe?

options.explanation: Hospitals are places where doctors and nurses work.
Policemen work at police stations to maintain law and order.
Schools are places where teachers teach students.
Farms are places where farmers grow crops.

questions.explanation: A police station is the main workplace for policemen who ensure safety, maintain law and order, and help people in need.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Which of these helpers uses a needle and thread to make clothes?

options.explanation: Carpenters work with wood to make furniture.
Tailors use needles and threads to make and repair clothes.
Drivers operate vehicles like cars and buses.
Chefs prepare food in restaurants or kitchens.

questions.explanation: A tailor is a person whose job is to make, mend, or alter clothes, especially suits and dresses, using a needle and thread.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: If your bicycle gets a flat tire, who can help you fix it?

options.explanation: Doctors treat sick people but do not fix bicycles.
Pilots fly airplanes and do not repair bicycles.
Mechanics repair and maintain vehicles, including bicycles.
Teachers educate students but do not fix bicycles.

questions.explanation: A mechanic is a skilled worker who repairs and maintains machinery, including vehicles like bicycles and cars.
questions.hint: Think about who fixes machines or vehicles.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Who grows fruits and vegetables for us to eat?

options.explanation: Bakers prepare bread and cakes but do not grow fruits or vegetables.
Farmers grow crops, fruits, and vegetables.
Sweepers clean streets and public places.
Firefighters extinguish fires and rescue people.

questions.explanation: Farmers work hard in the fields to cultivate crops, fruits, and vegetables that we consume.
questions.hint: Think about who works in fields and farms.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: I bring important letters and parcels to your home. Who am I?

options.explanation: Milkmen deliver milk to homes.
Postmen deliver letters and parcels.
Watchmen guard buildings and properties.
Cleaners maintain cleanliness in public places.

questions.explanation: A postman's job is to collect and deliver mail, including letters and parcels, to people's homes and offices.
questions.hint: Think about who delivers mail and parcels.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Why do we go to a grocery store?

options.explanation: Clothes are stitched by tailors, not sold in grocery stores.

options.text: To buy food items like rice and pulses
options.explanation: Grocery stores sell food items and household supplies.
Teeth are checked by dentists in clinics or hospitals.
Lessons are taught in schools by teachers.

questions.explanation: A grocery store is a retail shop that sells food and household supplies, such as rice, pulses, oil, snacks, and other daily necessities.
questions.hint: Think about what kind of items are sold in a grocery store.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Imagine there is a small fire in your kitchen. Who is the most important helper to call immediately?

options.explanation: Doctors treat sick people but do not extinguish fires.
Postmen deliver mail but do not handle fires.
Firefighters are trained to extinguish fires and rescue people.
Teachers educate students but do not handle fires.

questions.explanation: Firefighters are trained professionals who specialize in extinguishing fires and rescuing people from dangerous situations caused by fire. They should be called immediately in case of a fire.
questions.hint: Think about who is trained to handle fires.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Why do we need different community helpers like doctors, teachers, and farmers in our neighbourhood?

options.text: They all do the same work.
options.explanation: Each helper has a unique role and performs different tasks.

options.text: They help us in different ways with their special skills.
options.explanation: Doctors, teachers, and farmers all contribute uniquely to the community.
Community helpers assist everyone in the neighbourhood, regardless of wealth.
Community helpers work to improve the neighbourhood, not make it noisy.

questions.explanation: Each community helper has unique skills and performs a specific type of work that is essential for the smooth functioning and well-being of the community. They all contribute differently to our lives.
questions.hint: Think about how each helper contributes to the community in different ways.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Who helps us when we are sick and need medicine?

options.explanation: Teachers educate children in schools.
Postmen deliver letters and parcels.
Doctors treat patients and prescribe medicines.
Drivers operate vehicles like buses or cars.

questions.explanation: A doctor treats us when we are sick and prescribes medicine.
questions.hint: This person wears a white coat and works in a clinic or hospital.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Which of these tools does a carpenter mainly use to fix or build things with wood?

options.explanation: A stethoscope is used by doctors to listen to heartbeats.
A hammer is used by carpenters to drive nails into wood.
Scissors are used for cutting paper or cloth.
Needles are used by tailors or for sewing.

questions.explanation: A carpenter uses a hammer to join and shape wood for making furniture or other wooden items.
questions.hint: This tool has a heavy metal head and a wooden handle.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Who usually helps to prepare food for the family at home?

options.explanation: Drivers operate vehicles.
Mothers often prepare meals for their families.
Postmen deliver mail.
Pilots fly airplanes.

questions.explanation: Mothers often cook delicious food for their families at home.
questions.hint: This person is often a family member who takes care of cooking and other household tasks.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Where does a teacher work to teach children?

options.explanation: Hospitals are for medical treatment.
Post offices handle mail delivery.
Schools are where teachers teach children.
Markets are for buying and selling goods.

questions.explanation: A teacher works in a school, which is a place where children learn.
questions.hint: This is a place where students go to study and learn new things.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: I grow fresh fruits and vegetables in the fields for us to eat. Who am I?

options.explanation: Bakers prepare bread and cakes.
Farmers grow crops and vegetables.
Tailors sew clothes.
Plumbers fix water pipes.

questions.explanation: A farmer is the person who works hard to grow crops like fruits and vegetables in the fields.
questions.hint: This person works in fields and grows food for people to eat.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: If you want to buy fresh bread or cakes, who would you go to?

options.explanation: Grocers sell general food items.
Butchers sell meat.
Bakers prepare and sell bread and cakes.
Tailors sew clothes.

questions.explanation: A baker bakes fresh bread, cakes, and other delicious items, so you would buy them from a baker.
questions.hint: This person works in a bakery and makes bread and cakes.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Why is a cleaner important in our neighbourhood?

options.explanation: Teachers teach lessons in schools.
Cleaners maintain cleanliness in public spaces.
Postmen deliver letters.
Cobblers fix shoes.

questions.explanation: Cleaners help to keep our streets and public places tidy, which is important for everyone's health and hygiene.
questions.hint: This person ensures that public areas are clean and free from waste.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: If your school uniform is torn and needs stitching, who can help you fix it?

options.explanation: Carpenters work with wood.
Cobblers repair shoes.
Tailors sew and mend clothes.
Plumbers fix water pipes.

questions.explanation: A tailor is a person who sews, mends, and designs clothes.
questions.hint: This person works with needles and threads to repair or make clothes.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: You see smoke coming from your neighbour's house and suspect a fire. Who should you call for immediate help?

options.explanation: Postmen deliver mail.
Firefighters handle fire emergencies.
Doctors treat sick people.
Teachers educate students.

questions.explanation: Firefighters are specially trained to put out fires and help people in emergencies like a house fire.
questions.hint: This person's job is to respond to fires and rescue people.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: A police officer catches thieves, and a sweeper keeps our streets clean. This shows that:

options.explanation: Police officers are important, but so are other helpers.

options.text: All community helpers are important for different reasons.
options.explanation: Each helper contributes uniquely to the community.

options.text: Sweepers are not needed if there are police.
options.explanation: Both roles are essential for a clean and safe community.

options.text: Only one type of helper is enough for a community.
options.explanation: A community needs many types of helpers.

questions.explanation: Different community helpers do different jobs, and each job is important to make our community safe, clean, and well-functioning.
questions.hint: This means that all jobs in a community are valuable and necessary.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: What does a doctor use to listen to our heartbeat?

options.explanation: A hammer is used for hitting nails, not for listening to heartbeats.
A stethoscope is a medical tool used to listen to heartbeats and breathing.
A paintbrush is used for painting, not for medical purposes.
Scissors are used for cutting, not for listening to heartbeats.

questions.explanation: A doctor uses a stethoscope as a special tool to check a patient's heartbeat and breathing sounds.
questions.hint: It is a tool worn around the neck.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Who helps us learn new things and read books in school?

options.explanation: A postman delivers letters and parcels.
A teacher educates students and helps them learn.
A pilot flies airplanes.
A farmer grows crops and raises animals.

questions.explanation: A teacher's main job is to teach children and help them learn in school.
questions.hint: This person works in a classroom.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: If you want to buy fresh fruits and vegetables for your home, where should you go?

options.explanation: A hospital is where people go for medical treatment.
A post office is where people send and receive mail.
A market is where people buy fresh fruits, vegetables, and other items.
A school is where children go to study and learn.

questions.explanation: We go to the market where vendors sell fresh fruits, vegetables, and other goods.
questions.hint: It is a place where people buy and sell goods.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: Which helper grows food grains like wheat and rice for us to eat?

options.explanation: A doctor helps people stay healthy.
A policeman maintains law and order.
A farmer grows crops like wheat and rice.
A tailor makes clothes.

questions.explanation: A farmer is the person who works in the fields to grow crops and raise food for everyone.
questions.hint: This person works in fields and farms.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs

questions.question: It is raining heavily, and you need help to cross a busy road safely. Which helper can guide you to cross the road?

options.explanation: A teacher educates students in school.
A Traffic Police officer helps people cross busy roads safely.
A doctor treats sick people.
A baker makes bread and cakes.

questions.explanation: A Traffic Police officer controls the movement of vehicles and helps pedestrians, especially children, cross busy roads safely. This is particularly important in challenging conditions like heavy rain.
questions.hint: This helper wears a uniform and directs traffic.
questions.subject: cbse1-evs
